Name: Agumon Cat Replacer
Author: DonaldMcRoland123
Description:
How to install:

1. Locate Stardew Valley folder

2. Go to Stardew Valley folder

3. Click Content folder

4. Go to Animals folder

5. Replace the original file with the downloaded file

Make sure that the original file and the downloaded file has the same name or else it won't work.
